records.literal_gloss: A psalm of David. YHWH [is] my shepherd; I will not lack.

en.L: A psalm of David. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} [is] my shepherd; \q I will not lack [anything].
en.B: A psalm of David. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is my shepherd; \q I will never be in need.
en.R: A song of David. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} takes care of me like a shepherd. \q I have everything I need.

vi.L: [Một] thi thiên của Đa-vít. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] Đấng chăn giữ tôi; \q tôi sẽ không thiếu [gì].
vi.B: Thi thiên của Đa-vít. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đấng chăn dắt tôi; \q tôi sẽ chẳng bao giờ thiếu thốn.
vi.R: Bài ca của Đa-vít. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chăm sóc tôi như người chăn chăm sóc chiên. \q Tôi có đủ mọi điều mình cần.

ko.L: 다윗의 시. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 나의 목자이시다. \q 나는 [아무것도] 모자라지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 다윗의 시. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나의 목자이시니, \q 나는 아쉬울 것이 하나도 없다.
ko.R: 다윗이 지은 노래. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 목자처럼 나를 돌보아 주신다. \q 나에게는 필요한 것이 다 있다.

fr.L: Un psaume de David. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] mon berger ; \q je ne serai pas dans le manque.
fr.B: Un psaume de David. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est mon berger ; \q jamais je ne serai dans le besoin.
fr.R: Un chant de David. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} prend soin de moi comme un berger. \q J’ai tout ce qu’il me faut.

sw.L: Zaburi ya Daudi. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] mchungaji wangu; \q sitakosa [kitu].
sw.B: Zaburi ya Daudi. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mchungaji wangu; \q sitapata kuhitaji kitu kamwe.
sw.R: Wimbo wa Daudi. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ananitunza kama mchungaji. \q Nina kila kitu ninachohitaji.

es.L: Salmo de David. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es] mi pastor; \q no me faltará [nada].
es.B: Salmo de David. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es mi pastor; \q nunca pasaré necesidad.
es.R: Canto de David. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me cuida como un pastor. \q Tengo todo lo que necesito.

decisions.choice: The title shares verse 1
decisions.reason: This psalm's title is short and the Hebrew counts it together with the first line as verse 1, so here the verse numbers are the same as in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: my shepherd: the one who leads, feeds and guards
decisions.reason: A shepherd lived with his flock, led it to grass and water and fought off wild animals. Kings were called shepherds of their people, and God is the shepherd of Israel (80:2; Genesis 48:15; Ezekiel 34:11-15). Here he is "my" shepherd.

decisions.choice: I will not lack: I have and will have all I need
decisions.reason: The verb (chaser) is the one used of Israel in the wilderness: "you have lacked nothing" (Deuteronomy 2:7). Its form covers the present and the future.

decisions.choice: takes care of me like a shepherd
decisions.reason: Readable makes the picture a comparison and says what a shepherd does (m2).

decisions.choice: song
decisions.reason: As in 3:1.

decisions.choice: "thi thiên" (L, B), "bài ca" (R)
decisions.reason: "thi thiên" is the word Vietnamese Bible readers know for a psalm; Readable says "bài ca" (song), the plain word, as the English Readable says "song".

decisions.choice: the singer says "tôi" for himself
decisions.reason: "tôi" is the plain first person of a psalm's voice, used for the whole psalm. "con" is how a believer speaks to God in prayer, but the psalm is spoken about God before it turns to him (verse 4), and one word for the singer keeps the voice the same.

decisions.choice: Verses 1-3 speak about the LORD in the plain written style (해라체) with the honorific (-시-, 께서), and the singer calls himself "나"
decisions.reason: Style guide section 7a: the psalmist speaks about God in the plain written style and to God in 합쇼체 with 저. The psalm turns to address God in verses 4-5 (see the decision there) and speaks about him again in verse 6.

decisions.choice: YHWH is {{divine_name:주|야훼}} with the particle outside the span
decisions.reason: As the style guide (section 7a); "여호와", the form of the older Protestant Bibles, is not used. The same span stands in verse 6.

decisions.choice: drafted from the Hebrew gloss throughout, without the familiar Swahili wording of this psalm
alternatives: the wording most Swahili readers know by heart
decisions.reason: This psalm is one of the best known in Swahili, and its familiar wording belongs to a copyrighted Bible. Each line here is translated afresh from the Hebrew: "sitakosa kitu" (I will lack nothing) for the short Hebrew "I will not lack", "nyasi changa" for the fresh grass, "giza nene" for the deep darkness. Only short common phrases such as "BWANA ni mchungaji wangu" are shared.

decisions.choice: no me faltará [nada] (L); nunca pasaré necesidad (B); Tengo todo lo que necesito (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "I will not lack": with the LORD as shepherd, the psalmist has and will have all he needs. Each level is drafted from the Hebrew; Balanced and Readable say it in their own words rather than in the wording of older Spanish versions.

source.text: בִּנְא֣וֹת דֶּ֭שֶׁא יַרְבִּיצֵ֑נִי עַל־מֵ֖י מְנֻח֣וֹת יְנַהֲלֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: In pastures of fresh grass he makes me lie down; beside waters of rest he leads me.

en.L: In pastures of fresh grass {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} makes me lie down; \q beside waters of rest {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} leads me.
en.B: He settles me down in meadows of fresh green grass; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} leads me gently to water where I can rest.
en.R: He lets me rest in fields of soft green grass. \q He takes me to calm water where I can drink and rest.

vi.L: Trong đồng cỏ xanh tươi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho tôi nằm nghỉ; \q bên dòng nước của sự nghỉ ngơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dẫn tôi.
vi.B: Ngài cho tôi nằm nghỉ giữa những đồng cỏ non xanh mướt; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhẹ nhàng dẫn tôi đến dòng nước, nơi tôi được nghỉ ngơi.
vi.R: Ngài cho tôi nghỉ trên những cánh đồng cỏ xanh mềm. \q Ngài đưa tôi đến dòng nước êm, nơi tôi được uống và nghỉ ngơi.

ko.L: 새 풀의 목초지에 그분께서 나를 눕게 하시고, \q 쉼의 물 곁으로 나를 이끄신다.
ko.B: 그분께서 싱싱한 풀이 우거진 풀밭에 나를 눕히시고, \q 편히 쉴 수 있는 물가로 나를 부드럽게 이끄신다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 부드러운 풀밭에서 나를 쉬게 하신다. \q 잔잔한 물가로 나를 데려가 마시고 쉬게 하신다.

fr.L: Dans des pâturages d’herbe fraîche {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me fait coucher ; \q près des eaux du repos {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me conduit.
fr.B: Il m’installe dans des prés d’herbe verte et fraîche ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me mène doucement vers une eau où je peux me reposer.
fr.R: Il me laisse me reposer dans des champs d’herbe verte et tendre. \q Il m’emmène près d’une eau calme où je peux boire et me reposer.

sw.L: Katika mbuga za nyasi changa hunipumzisha; \q kando ya maji ya mapumziko ananielekeza.
sw.B: Ananilaza katika mbuga zenye nyasi mbichi za kijani; \q ananiongoza taratibu kwenye maji ninapoweza kupumzika.
sw.R: Ananiacha nipumzike katika mashamba ya nyasi laini za kijani. \q Ananipeleka kwenye maji yaliyotulia ninapoweza kunywa na kupumzika.

es.L: En prados de hierba fresca {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me hace recostar; \q junto a aguas de descanso {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me conduce.
es.B: Me hace tenderme en praderas de hierba verde y fresca; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me lleva con cuidado al agua donde puedo descansar.
es.R: Me deja descansar en campos de hierba verde y suave. \q Me lleva a aguas tranquilas donde puedo beber y descansar.

decisions.choice: he leads me: guides with care, to water and rest
decisions.reason: The verb (nahal) is used of leading a flock gently to water and of caring for the weak on the way (Isaiah 40:11; 49:10).

decisions.choice: waters of rest: water where the flock can rest
decisions.reason: The word (menuchot) means resting places, rest; the water is a place to drink and lie down in peace.

decisions.choice: where I can drink
decisions.reason: Readable says what the water is for.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Korean; God is "그분" with the honorific
decisions.reason: Hangul has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change; respect is carried by 그분, 께서 and -시- at every level (style guide section 7). This holds for the whole psalm.

source.text: נַפְשִׁ֥י יְשׁוֹבֵ֑ב יַֽנְחֵ֥נִי בְמַעְגְּלֵי־צֶ֝֗דֶק לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: My soul he brings back; he guides me in tracks of righteousness for the sake of his name.

en.L: My soul {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} brings back; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} guides me in tracks of righteousness \q for the sake of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name.
en.B: He brings back my life \q and leads me in the tracks of what is right, \q true to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name.
en.R: He makes me strong again. \q He shows me the right way to walk. \q He does this because of who {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is.

vi.L: Linh hồn tôi, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đem trở lại; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dắt tôi trên những lối mòn của sự công chính \q vì danh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Ngài phục hồi sức sống của tôi \q và dẫn tôi đi trên những lối ngay thẳng, \q đúng như danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Ngài làm cho tôi mạnh mẽ lại. \q Ngài chỉ cho tôi con đường đúng để đi. \q Ngài làm như vậy vì đó là bản tính của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 내 영혼을 그분께서 되살리신다. \q 그분께서 의의 길들로 나를 인도하시니, \q [이는] 그분의 이름을 위해서이다.
ko.B: 그분께서 내 생명을 다시 살리시고, \q 바른 길로 나를 이끄시니, \q 그분의 이름에 걸맞게 하시는 일이다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 나에게 다시 힘을 주신다. \q 바른 길로 걷도록 나를 이끄신다. \q 그분이 바로 그런 분이시기 때문이다.

fr.L: Mon âme, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} la ramène ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me guide sur des pistes de justice \q par égard pour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom.
fr.B: Il me rend la vie \q et me conduit sur les traces de ce qui est juste, \q fidèle à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom.
fr.R: Il me redonne des forces. \q Il me montre le bon chemin à suivre. \q Il fait cela pour rester fidèle à {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}}.

sw.L: Nafsi yangu anairudisha; \q ananiongoza katika mapito ya haki \q kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.
sw.B: Anayarudisha maisha yangu \q na kuniongoza katika mapito ya yaliyo sawa, \q kama jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} lilivyo.
sw.R: Ananipa nguvu tena. \q Ananionyesha njia sahihi ya kutembea. \q Anafanya hivi kwa sababu ya jinsi alivyo.

es.L: Mi alma {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hace volver; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me guía por huellas de justicia \q por causa de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre.
es.B: Me devuelve la vida \q y me lleva por las huellas de lo que es justo, \q fiel a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre.
es.R: Me da fuerzas otra vez. \q Me enseña el camino correcto por donde andar. \q Lo hace porque así es {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

decisions.choice: he brings back my soul: he gives me new life
alternatives: he brings me back (when I stray)
decisions.reason: To bring back the soul is to restore life and strength (19:8). The verb (shuv) can also mean to bring back a sheep that has strayed.

decisions.choice: tracks of righteousness: paths that are right
decisions.reason: The tracks (ma'gal) are worn paths. "Of righteousness" means paths that lead the right way, and also paths of living rightly; both are meant.

decisions.choice: for the sake of his name: because of who he is
decisions.reason: God acts to show what he is like and to keep his good name (Ezekiel 36:22).

decisions.choice: because of who he is
alternatives: for the sake of his name
decisions.reason: Readable says what the phrase means (m3).

decisions.choice: "vì đó là bản tính của Ngài" (because that is his nature)
decisions.reason: "For the sake of his name" means because of who he is (see the meaning decision); "danh Ngài" would be church language for new readers, so Readable says what the name stands for.

decisions.choice: "[이는] 그분의 이름을 위해서이다" as a sentence of its own
alternatives: 그분의 이름을 위하여 의의 길들로 나를 인도하신다
decisions.reason: Korean puts a purpose phrase before its verb; Literal makes the last colon its own sentence so that it stays on its own line after the leading, as in the Hebrew.

source.text: גַּ֤ם כִּֽי־אֵלֵ֨ךְ בְּגֵ֪יא צַלְמָ֡וֶת לֹא־אִ֘ירָ֤א רָ֗ע כִּי־אַתָּ֥ה עִמָּדִ֑י שִׁבְטְךָ֥ וּ֝מִשְׁעַנְתֶּ֗ךָ הֵ֣מָּה יְנַֽחֲמֻֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: Even when I walk in [a] valley of deep darkness, I will not fear harm, for you [are] with me; your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

en.L: Even when I walk in a valley of deep darkness, I will not fear harm, \q for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} [are] with me; \q {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} rod and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} staff, they comfort me.
en.B: Even if my path goes down through a valley of deepest darkness, I will not be afraid of any harm, \q because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are there with me; \q {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} rod and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} staff give me courage.
en.R: Even when I go through a valley that is very dark and dangerous, I will not be afraid, \q because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are right there beside me. \q You guard me with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} club and guide me with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} staff, and that comforts me.

vi.L: Dù khi tôi đi trong thung lũng bóng tối dày đặc, tôi sẽ không sợ tai họa, \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [ở] với tôi; \q cây roi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và cây gậy của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, chúng an ủi tôi.
vi.B: Dù đường tôi đi xuống thung lũng tối tăm nhất, tôi sẽ không sợ một tai họa nào, \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở đó với tôi; \q cây roi và cây gậy của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho tôi thêm can đảm.
vi.R: Dù khi tôi đi qua một thung lũng rất tối tăm và nguy hiểm, tôi sẽ không sợ, \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở ngay bên cạnh tôi. \q Ngài bảo vệ tôi bằng cây gậy ngắn và dẫn dắt tôi bằng cây gậy dài của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; điều đó làm tôi yên lòng.

ko.L: 제가 짙은 어둠의 골짜기를 걸을 때에도 해를 두려워하지 않을 것입니다. \q 주님께서 저와 함께 [계시기] 때문입니다. \q 주님의 막대기와 주님의 지팡이, 그것들이 저를 위로합니다.
ko.B: 깊디깊은 어둠의 골짜기로 제 길이 이어진다 해도, 저는 어떤 해도 두렵지 않습니다. \q 주님께서 저와 함께 계시기 때문입니다. \q 주님의 막대기와 지팡이가 저에게 용기를 줍니다.
ko.R: 아주 어둡고 위험한 골짜기를 지날 때에도 저는 무서워하지 않겠습니다. \q 주님께서 바로 제 곁에 계시기 때문입니다. \q 주님께서 몽둥이로 저를 지키시고 지팡이로 이끄시니, 저는 마음이 놓입니다.

fr.L: Même quand je marche dans une vallée de ténèbres profondes, je ne craindrai pas le malheur, \q car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} [es] avec moi ; \q {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} gourdin et {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} bâton, eux, me réconfortent.
fr.B: Même si mon chemin descend par une vallée aux ténèbres les plus épaisses, je n’aurai peur d’aucun mal, \q parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es là avec moi ; \q {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} gourdin et {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} bâton me donnent courage.
fr.R: Même quand je traverse une vallée très sombre et dangereuse, je n’aurai pas peur, \q parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es là, juste à côté de moi. \q Tu me défends avec {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} gourdin et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me guides avec {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} bâton, et cela me réconforte.

sw.L: Hata ninapotembea katika bonde la giza nene, sitaogopa madhara, \q kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} [u] pamoja nami; \q fimbo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} na mkongojo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, vinanifariji.
sw.B: Hata njia yangu ikishuka kupitia bonde la giza kuu kabisa, sitaogopa madhara yoyote, \q kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uko pale pamoja nami; \q fimbo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} na mkongojo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} vinanipa moyo.
sw.R: Hata ninapopita katika bonde lenye giza tupu na hatari, sitaogopa, \q kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uko pale kando yangu. \q Unanilinda kwa rungu {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} na kuniongoza kwa mkongojo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, na hilo linanifariji.

es.L: Aun cuando camine por un valle de profunda oscuridad, no tendré miedo del mal, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} [estás] conmigo; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} vara y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} cayado, ellos me consuelan.
es.B: Aunque mi senda baje por un valle de la más honda oscuridad, no tendré miedo de ningún daño, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} estás allí conmigo; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} vara y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} cayado me dan valor.
es.R: Aunque pase por un valle muy oscuro y peligroso, no tendré miedo, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} estás ahí mismo a mi lado. \q Tú me defiendes con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} garrote y me guías con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} cayado, y eso me consuela.

decisions.choice: deep darkness
decisions.reason: The word (tsalmavet) means deep, thick darkness (Job 10:21-22). It can also be read as two words, "shadow of death", which is how the ancient translations took it. Either way the valley is a place of danger where death is near.

decisions.choice: you are with me: the psalm turns to speak to God
decisions.reason: Until now the psalmist has spoken about the LORD; in the dark valley he speaks to him directly.

decisions.choice: rod and staff: a shepherd's weapon and walking stick
decisions.reason: The rod (shevet) was a club to drive off wild animals; the staff (mish'enet) a long stick to lean on and to guide the sheep. Both reassure the sheep that the shepherd is there.

decisions.choice: you guard me with your club and guide me with your staff
alternatives: your rod and your staff comfort me
decisions.reason: Readable says what each is for (m3).

decisions.choice: "Ngài" for "you" when the singer speaks to God, the same word as for "he"
decisions.reason: The style guide has the psalmist speak to God as "Ngài" or "Chúa"; "Ngài" keeps the deity_pronoun setting the English has here. But "Ngài" serves for both "he" and "you", so the turn from speaking about God to speaking to him, which the meaning decision points out, shows less than in Hebrew. A reviewer may prefer "Chúa" from here on.

decisions.choice: "cây gậy ngắn" (short club) and "cây gậy dài" (long staff)
decisions.reason: The shepherd's two sticks, a club to fight off animals and a long staff to guide the flock (see the meaning decision), named in plain words; "trượng" is a literary word.

decisions.choice: When the psalm turns to speak to God (verses 4-5), the singer uses 합쇼체 and calls himself "저"; God is addressed by title, "주님" (주님께서, 주님의)
decisions.reason: Style guide section 7a (speech levels in prayer). Korean addresses a superior by title, not by a pronoun; "당신" would be cold or rude. The change of level marks the turn to God that the Hebrew makes (meaning decision m2); verse 6 returns to speaking about the LORD. A reviewer may prefer one level for the whole psalm.

decisions.choice: "gourdin" and "bâton" for the shepherd's two sticks
decisions.reason: The first is the shepherd's club for driving off wild animals, the second his walking stick (m3). "Gourdin" says plainly that it is a weapon; "houlette" and "verge" are old words few readers now picture.

decisions.choice: "ténèbres profondes" (Literal), "les ténèbres les plus épaisses" (Balanced), "très sombre et dangereuse" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The word means deep darkness (m1); the traditional "ombre de la mort" reads it as two words, which the meaning decision leaves aside.

source.text: תַּעֲרֹ֬ךְ לְפָנַ֨י׀שֻׁלְחָ֗ן נֶ֥גֶד צֹרְרָ֑י דִּשַּׁ֖נְתָּ בַשֶּׁ֥מֶן רֹ֝אשִׁ֗י כּוֹסִ֥י רְוָיָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: You arrange before me a table in front of my foes; you have refreshed with oil my head; my cup [is] overflowing.

en.L: You set a table before me in front of my foes; \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have refreshed my head with oil; \q my cup [is] overflowing.
en.B: You spread a meal before me while my enemies look on; \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} refresh my head with oil, \q and my cup is full to the brim.
en.R: You set out a feast for me, and my enemies have to watch. \q You pour oil on my head to honor me. \q You fill my cup until it spills over.

vi.L: Ngài bày một cái bàn trước mặt tôi, ngay trước những kẻ thù của tôi; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm tươi mới đầu tôi bằng dầu; \q chén của tôi tràn ra.
vi.B: Ngài dọn tiệc cho tôi trong khi kẻ thù tôi đứng nhìn; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} xức dầu làm tươi mát đầu tôi, \q và chén tôi đầy đến tràn miệng.
vi.R: Ngài dọn một bữa tiệc cho tôi, và kẻ thù tôi phải đứng nhìn. \q Ngài đổ dầu trên đầu tôi để tôn trọng tôi. \q Ngài rót đầy chén tôi đến nỗi tràn ra.

ko.L: 주님께서 제 대적들 앞에서 제 앞에 상을 차리십니다. \q 기름으로 제 머리를 윤기 나게 하셨습니다. \q 제 잔이 넘칩니다.
ko.B: 주님께서는 제 원수들이 지켜보는 가운데 제 앞에 식탁을 차려 주십니다. \q 제 머리에 기름을 발라 새 힘을 주시니, \q 제 잔이 가득 차 넘칩니다.
ko.R: 주님께서 저를 위해 잔치를 베푸시니, 제 원수들은 그것을 지켜볼 수밖에 없습니다. \q 주님께서 제 머리에 기름을 부어 저를 귀히 여겨 주십니다. \q 주님께서 제 잔을 넘치도록 채워 주십니다.

fr.L: Tu prépares devant moi une table sous les yeux de mes adversaires ; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as rafraîchi d’huile ma tête ; \q ma coupe [est] débordante.
fr.B: Tu m’offres un repas pendant que mes ennemis regardent ; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rafraîchis ma tête avec de l’huile, \q et ma coupe est remplie à ras bord.
fr.R: Tu prépares un festin pour moi, et mes ennemis doivent regarder. \q Tu verses de l’huile sur ma tête pour m’honorer. \q Tu remplis ma coupe jusqu’à ce qu’elle déborde.

sw.L: Unaandaa meza mbele yangu machoni pa watesi wangu; \q umekiburudisha kichwa changu kwa mafuta; \q kikombe changu kinamwagika kwa kujaa.
sw.B: Unaniandalia mlo mbele yangu huku adui zangu wakitazama; \q unakiburudisha kichwa changu kwa mafuta, \q na kikombe changu kimejaa hadi ukingoni.
sw.R: Unaniandalia karamu, na adui zangu wanalazimika kutazama. \q Unanimiminia mafuta kichwani kunipa heshima. \q Unakijaza kikombe changu mpaka kinamwagika.

es.L: Tú preparas una mesa delante de mí frente a mis adversarios; \q {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has refrescado mi cabeza con aceite; \q mi copa [está] rebosando.
es.B: Tú me sirves un banquete mientras mis enemigos miran; \q {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} refrescas mi cabeza con aceite, \q y mi copa está llena hasta el borde.
es.R: Tú me preparas una fiesta, y mis enemigos tienen que mirar. \q Tú derramas aceite sobre mi cabeza para honrarme. \q Tú llenas mi copa hasta que se desborda.

decisions.choice: a table before my foes: God as host
decisions.reason: The picture changes from shepherd to host. A host who welcomed a guest to his table was bound to protect him; the enemies can only watch.

decisions.choice: refreshed with oil: welcomed and honored
decisions.reason: The verb (dishen) means to make rich or fat, here to refresh with oil. Oil on the head was a mark of welcome and gladness for a guest (104:15; Luke 7:46), not the anointing of a king.

decisions.choice: my cup overflowing: more than enough
decisions.reason: The cup is the portion one is given (16:5); his runs over.

decisions.choice: to honor me
decisions.reason: Readable says what the oil means (m2).

source.text: אַ֤ךְ׀ט֤וֹב וָחֶ֣סֶד יִ֭רְדְּפוּנִי כָּל־יְמֵ֣י חַיָּ֑י וְשַׁבְתִּ֥י בְּבֵית־יְ֝הוָ֗ה לְאֹ֣רֶךְ יָמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Surely goodness and loyal love will pursue me all [the] days of my life, and I will return in [the] house of YHWH for length of days.

en.L: Surely goodness and loyal love will pursue me all the days of my life, \q and I will return [to dwell] in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for length of days.
en.B: Goodness and loyal love will surely chase after me every day I live, \q and I will come home to the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for all my days to come.
en.R: I am sure that goodness and faithful love will run after me every day of my life. \q And I will come back to live in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s house for as long as I live.

vi.L: Chắc chắn sự tốt lành và tình yêu thương thành tín sẽ đuổi theo tôi suốt mọi ngày của đời tôi, \q và tôi sẽ trở về [ở] trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho đến những ngày dài lâu.
vi.B: Chắc chắn sự tốt lành và tình yêu thương thành tín sẽ đuổi theo tôi mỗi ngày trong đời tôi, \q và tôi sẽ về lại nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} suốt những ngày còn lại.
vi.R: Tôi chắc chắn rằng sự tốt lành và tình thương không hề thay đổi sẽ chạy theo tôi mỗi ngày trong đời. \q Và tôi sẽ trở về sống trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} suốt đời tôi.

ko.L: 참으로 선함과 한결같은 사랑이 내 삶의 모든 날 동안 나를 뒤쫓을 것이다. \q 나는 긴 날들 동안 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집으로 돌아와 [살] 것이다.
ko.B: 선함과 한결같은 사랑이 내가 사는 날 동안 반드시 나를 뒤쫓아 올 것이니, \q 나는 앞으로 내 모든 날을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 돌아와 머물 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 사는 모든 날 동안 좋은 것과 변함없는 사랑이 나를 따라다닐 것이 분명하다. \q 그리고 나는 살아 있는 동안 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 돌아와 살 것이다.

fr.L: Oui, le bien et l’amour loyal me poursuivront tous les jours de ma vie, \q et je reviendrai [habiter] dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} pour la longueur des jours.
fr.B: Le bien et l’amour fidèle me suivront à la trace chaque jour de ma vie, \q et je rentrerai chez moi, dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, pour tous les jours à venir.
fr.R: Je suis sûr que le bien et l’amour fidèle courront après moi chaque jour de ma vie. \q Et je reviendrai vivre dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} aussi longtemps que je vivrai.

sw.L: Hakika wema na upendo usiokoma vitanifuatia siku zote za maisha yangu, \q nami nitarudi [kukaa] katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa wingi wa siku.
sw.B: Wema na upendo usiokoma hakika vitanifuata mbio kila siku ninayoishi, \q nami nitarudi nyumbani katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa siku zangu zote zijazo.
sw.R: Nina hakika kwamba wema na upendo usiokoma vitanifuata kila siku ya maisha yangu. \q Nami nitarudi kuishi katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} maadamu ninaishi.

es.L: Ciertamente el bien y el amor leal me perseguirán todos los días de mi vida, \q y volveré [a habitar] en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} por largura de días.
es.B: El bien y el amor fiel de seguro correrán tras de mí cada día que viva, \q y volveré a casa, a la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, por todos los días que vengan.
es.R: Estoy seguro de que la bondad y el amor fiel me seguirán cada día de mi vida. \q Y volveré a vivir en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} mientras viva.

decisions.choice: pursue me: chase after me
decisions.reason: The verb (radaf) is usually used of enemies in pursuit (7:2). Here the enemies of verse 5 only watch, and God's goodness and love are what chase him.

decisions.choice: loyal love: chesed
decisions.reason: As in 21:8, love that keeps faith with a bond.

decisions.choice: I will return
alternatives: I will dwell (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text has "I will return" (shavti), with "in the house" as if "to dwell" were understood. The ancient Greek translation read "I will dwell" (veyashavti), a very similar word. Either way he will be at home with God.

decisions.choice: for length of days: as long as I live
decisions.reason: Length of days is a long life (21:5).

decisions.choice: faithful love
decisions.reason: Readable says "faithful love" for chesed (m2).

decisions.choice: return (L); come home (B)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced follow the Hebrew text (m3); Readable says "come back to live", which keeps both senses.

decisions.choice: "tình yêu thương thành tín" (L, B); "tình thương không hề thay đổi" (R)
decisions.reason: The word is love that keeps faith with a covenant (see the meaning decision). "sự thương xót" (mercy) and "lòng nhân từ" (kindness) each give only part of it; "thành tín" adds the loyalty. Readable says the same in everyday words.

decisions.choice: "한결같은 사랑" (L, B), "변함없는 사랑" (R) for chesed
decisions.reason: The word is love that stays loyal (meaning decision); "인자하심" is the older church word and now unclear to many readers, and "자비" says mercy only. The same Korean term should hold for chesed through the Psalter.

decisions.choice: Back to the plain written style with "나"
alternatives: 저 and 합쇼체 as in verses 4-5
decisions.reason: The verse speaks of "the house of the LORD" in the third person, so it is speech about God again (style guide section 7a), as in verses 1-3.

decisions.choice: me perseguirán (L); correrán tras de mí (B)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb is "pursue", the word used for an enemy chasing someone (7:6); here goodness and loyal love chase the psalmist. Literal and Balanced keep that force; Readable says "me seguirán", as the English Readable says "run after".
